method: Actual rendered images opened with the image reader; pose strips and full-resolution details. Numeric every-frame evidence is separate.
findings: Rest appearance matches the accepted painted costume and MPFB head; original topology/UV/maps also checked numerically.
Boot cuff now follows the shin; the sole stays planted during stance. Knee folds remain coarse at large bends.
Sword grip, pommel and crossguard are separate visible forms around the closed fist. Ready blade projects outside the silhouette.
Cuirass and pauldrons retain rigid forms in inspected pilot poses. Face, eyes, brows and hair remain coherent.
Coat and cape react to the limbs/torso. Thin skirt edges appear in side stride views; a deep squat exposes a small rear opening outside the delivered pilot range.
A fast forearm recovery flip was corrected with an outward blade arc and periodic quaternion smoothing; all source frames pass continuity and blade-path checks.
Four-view boards show the actual model and source motion. Rear views naturally occlude parts of the forward-facing sword.
